name: Taimaninverse Zeta
source:
A fan Visual Novel taking place in the (in)famous(?) 'Taimaninverse' setting from game producer 'Lilith Soft'.

Following an alternate ending to the game 'Taimanin Asagi 3'.


Two years have passed since the 'Time of Troubles' which affected the whole of Japan.

Underneath Tokyo, the underground Demon Town of Yomihara, once the center of power of NOMAD, still remains.

But things have changed......


Hero and villain alike have been bloodied. Some characters are gone, and new power players have come to the fore. A new threat is slowly rising from the shadows of the vacuum left by the disappearance of the old rulers.  On the surface world, politics continue to play out, as always.

One night, a Yomiharan slave meets secretly with a reporter who infiltrated the Buried City for an interview.

At the same time, another slave is sent to deliver a message by his Owner...... and his already terrible life is about to get even more complicated.

[From [url=//edsan-games.itch.io/taimaninverse-zeta]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部粉丝视觉小说，发生在游戏制作人“Lilith Soft”的（不）著名（？）“Taimanverse”背景中。

继游戏“Taimanin Asagi 3”的另一个结局之后。


影响全日本的“动乱时期”已经过去两年了。

在东京地下，曾经是NOMAD权力中心的地下恶魔城读原仍然存在。

但事情已经发生了变化……


英雄和恶棍都曾流过血。一些角色消失了，新的强力玩家脱颖而出。旧统治者消失所留下的真空阴影中，新的威胁正在慢慢升起。在地表世界，政治一如既往地继续上演。

一天晚上，一名读哈拉奴隶秘密会见一名潜入掩埋之城进行采访的记者。

与此同时，主人又派出另一个奴隶去传递消息……他本就糟糕的生活即将变得更加复杂。

[来自[url=//edsan-games.itch.io/taimaninverse-zeta]Itch.io[/url]]
